Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You are already moving before your friend sees the blow.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared but before its roll.
Duration
Instant
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a shield. Grants one ordinary shield, Bulk 1, if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Defense

While holding a shield, replace the ally as the target if you meet the attack’s range and targeting requirements. Resolve that attack against you once, using your defense if one is called for. The ally takes none of this attack’s effects. You do not move; this cannot redirect an area attack.
